reviews.author: Ariane Azzi
reviews.text: Comfort Shield has been great! We had our HVAC breaking during a heat wave. They came the same day to do a free quote for us. Once we signed the contract with them, they were able to come back for instal in 2 days. They were super patient with me as I had so many questions and was back and forth with them over email and they always promptly answer my questions. They were very fairly priced too. I got quotes from 4 other places and they were SO HIGH and for worse quality units. One of the quotes I got, the guy sat on his truck for about half an hour talking to somebody to finally give me a quote and when he came back, he overcharged us by 3k for “difficult access” to my air handler in the crawlspace. When Comfort Shield came to quote, Courtney said that our air handler was very easy access as it is right at the entrance of our crawlspace, and the installers were so happy when they saw where it was too because it was easy for them to reach. This only tells me how bad companies try to rip you off at all costs, so it is important that you have someone you trust to do this kind of work for you. I had another quote that was 3.5x more expensive than I paid with Comfort Shield for lower quality units too. If you are looking for an honest and affordable company, this is it, go with Comfort Shield. I will do my second upstairs unit with them again when it finally decides to retire.

reviews.text: This is the first company that has been honest and not tried to upsell us on something we didn't need. We will use only Comfort Shield in the future! Thank you so much! Sara Moerbe

reviews.author: Flynn Greer
reviews.text: Exceptional Service from Comfort Shield HVAC! I had an amazing experience with Comfort Shield HVAC! From start to finish, the entire process was smooth, professional, and stress-free. The team was incredibly responsive and made scheduling easy. The technicians were absolutely incredible, professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely courteous. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and made sure I fully understood the work being done. You can tell they truly care about their customers and take pride in what they do. A very special shout-out to Courtney, who worked patiently with us from the beginning to the end of our HVAC installation. Courtney was attentive, supportive, and made sure everything stayed on track. That level of care and commitment truly made a difference in our experience. Not only did they complete the job efficiently, but the quality of their work exceeded my expectations. They were respectful of my home, worked neatly, and left everything in great condition. If you're looking for reliable, honest, and top-tier HVAC service, I highly recommend Comfort Shield HVAC. These guys are the real deal!

reviews.author: Lisa Edmundson

reviews.text: Justess did a great job for our spring maintenance of our system. reviews.text: David Turner was amazing! He literally just left my house and I couldn’t be happier with the service. reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: I was having an issue with my unit not keeping my house cool. I called Comfort Shield and had a tech scheduled to come out. The gentleman said that the unit was low on Freon and suggested that I have him do a leak test. He told me what the cost would be. I told him to go ahead and after a while he came in and said he couldn’t find a leak and I approved him charging the system with Freon. About a month or maybe 2 goes by and I have the same issue, so I called again to have someone to come out. The tech went out and came back in after only several minutes and said he found a leak. My response was how he could find it so fast when the previous tech could not. He then showed me a video of where the “leak is”. I expressed my displeasure and he said due to it being so late in the day turn the information in and someone would call me the next morning with a quote on the repair. I asked that they also quote me a new unit. Next morning no one called and after waiting until 1pm I called and was told the quote hadn’t been done and she would have it completed and someone would call. After waiting a few more hours of no call I found someone else and called them. He said he would be out the next day. I did receive two emails with the quotes, no one called to discuss the quotes or the discrepancies between the two techs. Very disappointing and to me unprofessional.

reviews.author: Kassandra Holloway
reviews.text: Jon-Michael came to look at our air conditioner today, it had stopped working on Sat. My husband and I were prepared for a large bill, and much to our surprise he had it up and running in minutes. Jon-Michael was professional, clean and gave us great tips. So glad we were referred to Comfort Shield. Thank you for being an honest company.

reviews.author: Ray Man
reviews.text: looking forward to retirement I wanted to upgrade my 25 year old heat pump thinking something less to worry about during retirement. my 25 year old unit still working was more efficient than this Heil unit recently installed. the said to be efficient Heil unit runs non stop. i can set heat down a couple degrees, it shuts down until desired temp then comes back on non stop. so much for looking ahead to retirement. I would not recommend the low quality Heil units Comfort Shield sales I am using space heaters due to this low quality Heil unit. Don't waste your money. So I have paid 8k for this heil unit and now I sit here in freezing cold weather without heat. Don't let these people rip you off to

reviews.author: William Godley
reviews.text: Billy and nate were absolutely amazing. Billy is a wealth of knowledge and likes to teach you what he's doing. Nate is newer to the trade but has the attitude to do the job and do it right. He soaked up knowledge the whole time he was here and worked harder than most people his age would even think about. They are the only ones I would trust with my plumbing and will be having them out again to help do some upgrades to my houses plumbing.

reviews.author: Paul Stubbs
reviews.text: Comfort Shield tech came out on a weekend when I couldn't get a tech from a company that I used previously. Took the time to go through and correct problems that had not been properly addressed. System still wasn't running quite right and the next day the owner came back with the tech and worked through more problems that they found and all at no charge. Great work. Outstanding customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David Manista
reviews.text: Saturday, heats out. Called and scheduled an appointment. Received a text message from Jon Michael when he was coming. Again received excellent service and he solved our problem quickly and professionally. Thank you Jon.

reviews.author: Lindsay Simon
reviews.text: Great service from the Comfort Shield team! Jon Michael and Justess were very thorough and knowledgeable. They presented well and were professional.

reviews.author: Gianna King
reviews.text: Extremely happy with the Service of Comfort Shield HVAC. Our AC went down on a Sunday afternoon and by Monday morning 8am it was back up and running. I couldn't be happier with the rapid response of the Company and the very nice man who came to my home super early and fixed everything. Also when the office called to coordinate a crew member to come to my house; Courtney in their office was such a nice and sweet person and got someone out to us ASAP. Thank you guys!!! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: C Brown
reviews.text: My AC started to go out as soon as I got home on a Friday and was completely out by Saturday night. Most of the places that were recommend to me didn’t offer weekend services, so I thought I’d have to wait til Monday. I did a little research on my end and found this company. They offer 24 hours services and in my case I called, and they sent out the guru Nick Mumby within the hour. Nick definitely had his work cut out for him, but he was extremely knowledgeable, friendly and thorough. I could tell immediately that he takes pride in his work. He explained the processes in a way that was easy for me to understand (I’ve never dealt with AC units up close and personal). He even got rid of a nasty wasp nest that was forming in front of the house lol. I took a chance on this company for the reviews alone and I recommend Comfort Shield to all homeowners that have HVAC needs. They are top notch!!

reviews.author: Roy Ringenberg
reviews.text: Donnie did great work! He came quickly for the first service call, even before he was scheduled. He got the replacement part the next day and had it working before 9 a.m. A billing problem got resolved quickly by Nicole in the office. Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Norman Block
reviews.text: We just had Patrick and Harris come to our home and service all three toilets. One was running, the others had age problems. These guys were super nice, very knowledgeable, and did a great job! Great experience!

reviews.author: Gordon Williams
reviews.text: Quick and efficient. The tech walked me through what was going wrong and gave me some suggestions. My HVAC system was back up and running within a few hours of the first call.

reviews.author: Tiffany Steele
reviews.text: Kris was friendly and thorough with explaining what needs to be done on my unit. Also very empathetic to the situation and that's super important these days!

reviews.author: James Wetterau
reviews.text: Comfort Shield did an excellent job of repairing my HVAC system. They were thorough and efficient and did a total system replacement in a reasonable time at a fair price.

reviews.author: Tammy Koger
reviews.text: Tim and the team at Comfort Shield are the best. Always nice, responsive and a pleasure. Highly recommend this team of professionals.

reviews.author: Charlie Walker
reviews.text: Kris was prompt and efficient in the plumbing repair. You all responded within 45 minutes of my call and completed the job with no inconvenience to the church. Thanks!

reviews.author: Sharbara Ellis
reviews.text: Billy and his partner were excellent technicians and provided great costumer service. I highly recommend Comfort Shields and will use them again.

reviews.author: Hannah Skinner
reviews.text: Jon-Micheal came on an emergency service call, he was professional and efficient. Our outdoor AC unit stopped working on one of the hottest days so far this year, he had it up and running and was in and out within 20 minutes from his knock on our door.

reviews.author: Phyllis Hall
reviews.text: Absoulety so excited they came out the day I called. They always do excellent work !! They put my heat pump in,they put all new ducking in and did an awesome job.Come to think of it after having all that done by them ,why not a discount given?

reviews.author: Cutter Wyatt
reviews.text: John was incredibly thorough and quick when installing my new oven hood. He went as far as disposing of the old unit, disposing of all packaging, and sweeping the floor when he was done. Whatever they’re paying him isn’t enough, give that man a raise.

reviews.author: Ebony Artis
reviews.text: They were fast and prompt with responses and completion of job. Very cordial and nice people. I would recommend for all your home care needs!! They do it all!!!!

reviews.author: Donna Banks
reviews.text: There was an emergency call to Comfort Shield and they came. Sean was professional and courteous. Found the problem and fixed it. He showed us pictures of the repair and the part. Good job!

reviews.author: NC Kitkat
reviews.text: Cameron explained all that he was checking and possible causes- he was very professional. I appreciate his help very much, especially on a very stormy night!

reviews.author: pj garrett
reviews.text: I called after hours and Andrew showed up in 20 minutes Andrew did a great job to solve our plumbing emergency! I would highly recommend Comfort Shield Thank you for your urgent response

reviews.author: Kat J
reviews.text: Called when my AC froze up during the heat wave, they had a technician come out the same day and made sure I had cooling that day. Friendly and professional technicians, office staff is amazing along. This company has very competitive pricing.

reviews.author: Terrance Wilson
reviews.text: Excellent experience. The technician was ontime, friendly, courteous, and took the time to explain what he was doing. Great job.

reviews.author: siar kakar
reviews.text: They listen and communicate very well. Discuss the details of the problem and the solution options. The site workers are great. They provide the options of financing. Strongly Recommended.

reviews.author: Alex Grady
reviews.text: I was very satisfied with the help and professional work from this company. I called and they responded on a Saturday night. I would recommend this fantastic company to anyone who needs plumbing help. Thank you Comfort Shield.

reviews.author: Rebecca Fisher
reviews.text: Errors with communication, extended time to complete a simple task- I’d just pay for it out of pocket to get it done at this point. Their response to my rating reiterates my point. Just had another company fix the problem in a day that I waited almost 2 weeks for because of policies.

reviews.author: Troy Thomas
reviews.text: Justess was a very good house guest today. He fixed the problem and even wore shoe protection. We appreciate him and he deserves a raise !

reviews.author: Rebeca Rodriguez
reviews.text: Great work and costumer service had my heater running in no time due to a quick and efficient service man named justice replaced parts on my unit even after dark so I definitely recommend this company without a doubt. Thank you very much

reviews.author: Timothy Myles
reviews.text: Charges my card twice and had to file a dispute with my bank. $900+ they did some good work just need to keep track of their finances better

reviews.author: katherine foley
reviews.text: John Michael took care of the problem quickly & professionally. Knowledgeable and had a very kindly respectful demeanor. Thank you comfort shield!

reviews.author: Al Godley
reviews.text: Jon-Michael, Brian, Gustavo and Alex did a wonderful job selling, answering questions, and installing a new gas pack for our home. I recommend Comfort Shield and the people there.

reviews.author: Kathy Johnson
reviews.text: David Turner is simply the best, he is efficient and knowledgeable and we always feel like we have been given the best service. I cannot recommend him enough.

reviews.author: Ervin Gaylord
reviews.text: Chris and his assistant are top notch and the best that I have ever seen. This company will always be my go to company for for all of my repairs.

reviews.author: Just Jon
reviews.text: They beat three quotes by a good amount of money and did an extremely great installation of a new system at my home. Very professional and very prompt in getting it set up after the quote. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Richard Maximilian
reviews.text: Great company and awesome technicians, We just had our A/C unit repaired and our technician John Michael was punctual, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to insure that our unit was in its best possible shape by checking for any signs of possible problems before he left. Great guy

reviews.author: James Fouts
reviews.text: Tim, TJ, and the team at Comfort Shield are truly exceptional with the services they provide. After several very bad HVAC service experiences with other companies, it is great to know that companies like Comfort Shield are still out there. If you need HVAC service in the area, please give them a call.

reviews.author: John Koger
reviews.text: Absolutely best service ever. Never fails when i have an issue they are there. By far best service in NC.

reviews.author: patricia bedrosian
reviews.text: Our technician Justess was very professional and knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue and did the necessary repairs!

reviews.author: Ruby Simmons
reviews.text: It was an awesome experience, one in which we will continue to call them for future plumbing needs. They were excellent and great to work with!

reviews.author: Johnetta Gray
reviews.text: Billy did an excellent job and even cleaned up the stagnant water from the overflow. Same day service and top notch customer service! Thanks Billy!

reviews.author: Tasha Wilson
reviews.text: Always a great company to deal with. Always timely and always friendly to us. Love doing business with this company. Keystone Management loves the work.

reviews.author: Tracy Buckner
reviews.text: Quick response time and excellent customer service. Very polite and knowledgeable repairman. Great overall experience!

reviews.author: heidi miranda
reviews.text: Professional, knowledgeable and has the right leadership in their office to assist if the tech does not know exactly what the issues is. I will 100% use this company again.

reviews.author: Jacob Strauss
reviews.text: Extremely quick and professional. Arrived at the time they said they would and fixed the problem quickly and efficiently.

reviews.author: Pat Wagstaff
reviews.text: Technician came out to make repair and was very professional and courteous. After making the repair, he checked and verified everything was working as it should. Very much appreciated.

reviews.author: Los
reviews.text: Got out to help me quick as possible. Technician was nice, polite, and fixed problem right away. Great experience

reviews.author: javontae davis
reviews.text: I didn’t even have to be home. Gave them the access code and when I got home my unit was blowing cold like the arctic. Thank you Justess Macinnis was the technician

reviews.author: Michael Tyree
reviews.text: Great place to get service for your HVAC issues, plumbing, and electrical issues too. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Richard Bradford
reviews.text: I purchased an H&A system from your company and when I tried to get it serviced you said you no longer cover my area for servicing . Please quit sending me information on your company or products. I had to give you 1 star so I could post this.

reviews.author: Mary Crowell
reviews.text: It's awful that the people have to keep coming because of the problem the toilet seems to be having. Hopefully they got it done right this time.

reviews.author: Michele Hoffner
reviews.text: Billy and Kris was awesome from start to finish! I definitely will be using them for all future plumbing needs
